output.summary: Waterside carrot-family plant of unspecified native origin, widespread across much of Europe, Asia, Australia and North America. Its hollow stems bear thread-like leaves underwater and broader leaves above water, while crushed stalks smell of carrot or parsnip. The Zuni use it in schumaakwe cakes.
output.edibilityNote: The Zuni people use the plant as an ingredient in schumaakwe cakes.
